notes.title: Knights and Guns are Out Now!
notes.notes:
Join the fray as "Knights and Guns" debuts on Steam! This game melds the thrill of medieval combat with the explosive power of modern weaponry in a fantastically chaotic adventure.

Step into a realm where every battle is a chance to rewrite history with bullets and bravery. "Knights and Guns" offers an intense, action-packed experience, challenging players to conquer foes in a non-linear world filled with surprises.

Don't miss out on the action! "Knights and Guns" is now live, inviting you to unleash mayhem with an arsenal of powerful weapons and armor. Are you ready to become the hero in a clash of epochs?

notes.title: STEAM NEXT FEST LIVE STREAM
notes.notes:
Gather, gallant heroes, for an exclusive live stream event featuring Knights and Guns, straight from Steam Next Fest! 

Journey with us as we plunge into exhilarating encounters and uncover the myriad wonders and challenges that lie within. It's your unique chance to see the game's lush landscapes, pulse-pounding combat, and intricate mechanics up close.

notes.title: Knights and Guns: Gameplay Stream at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Attention, valiant knights! Ready your weapons and gather around as we bring you the first live gameplay stream of Knights and Guns during Steam Next Fest. Join us as we delve into the heart of battle, showcasing the exciting features, intense combat, and vibrant worlds that await you.

Mark your calendars!

notes.title: Knights and Guns: Stream at Steam Next Fest Part 2
notes.notes:
The adventure continues, noble warriors! If you missed our first stream or simply crave more, our second Knights and Guns gameplay stream at Steam Next Fest is your call to arms. 

Prepare for another round of exhilarating action, detailed walkthroughs, and community camaraderie.
